title: Less chasing. Clearer client decisions.
text: Clientlane helps freelancers and small studios gather inputs, review versions, agree changes, and hand over approved work.

title: Ask for the content you need
text: Requests put instructions and deadlines in one place. Here the designer asks the café for its final launch message.

title: Feedback stays with this version
text: Asha reviews Homepage design, adds feedback, and asks for a clearer opening-hours section. One revision round is counted.

title: Publish a new version
text: The designer makes the requested change and uploads a private handover note. Earlier feedback stays attached to version 1.

title: Make added scope explicit
text: The café asks for three seasonal drink illustrations. Extra work gets its own request, quote, and client decision.

title: Leave with approved work
text: Handover contains the latest approved delivery and its private file. Both sides have a clear record of what was decided.
